verdict.rationale: Drata's developer docs say the platform can "automate questionnaires and manage your trust center programmatically." That confirms a first-party questionnaire-automation capability, but nothing in the pack shows importing or exporting questionnaires in their original formats. missing for 10: documented import of SIG/CAIQ/spreadsheet questionnaires, support for customer security-review portals, export back in the customer's original format, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
